title: Faster and faster
summary: Speed grows with the score, the record is kept on the phone, and there are sounds.
done: You saw a speed formula, a variable kept on the phone, and sounds.

hello.text: In level 4, it gets faster and faster, your record is kept, and there are sounds.

speed.text: The speed is a calculation: 150 + score × 10. With 5 points, the star falls at 200.

best.text: The **best** variable is *stored*: the phone keeps it, even when the app is closed. We change it only if the score is bigger.

sound.text: A **Sound** component plays a little noise for each star caught.

slow.text: Start **slow motion**: blocks will light up one by one while the game runs.

watch.text: Watch the speed block light up for each new star.
watch.hint: Wait a little, or click “Restart” in the preview.

fast.text: Well spotted! Stop slow motion to play at normal speed again.

gentle.text: Speed up more gently: 5 per point instead of 10.
gentle.hint: It is the 10 in the speed calculation.

quick.text: Make stars start at 200 instead of 150.
quick.hint: It is the 150 in the speed calculation.

sad.text: Play a sound when the game is lost.
sad.hint: Put [play MissSound] in the [if] of “check if the game is lost”.
